# ScrapeAgent — agent usage guide

Pay-per-use public web-page text extraction for AI agents.
Advertised price: $0.01 USD per request via x402. No API key or subscription.

## Endpoint

POST https://scrapeagent.xyz/api/scrape/x402

## Supported input

Send JSON with a required `url` field:

```json
{ "url": "https://example.com" }
```

The current implementation returns readable text only. The `extract` options previously shown in some examples are not supported by this endpoint yet. Only public HTTP(S) URLs are intended; local/private addresses and redirects are rejected. HTML and plain-text responses are supported, with a 1 MB upstream response limit and a maximum 10,000-character text result.

## Payment

The endpoint returns HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements when no payment proof is supplied. The challenge currently advertises $0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453), Arc (eip155:5042), and Polygon (eip155:137). Check the returned challenge before authorizing any payment; never trust a copied wallet address over the live payment requirements.

## Successful response

```json
{
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "text": "Extracted page text...",
  "length": 23,
  "scraped_at": "2026-10-15T12:00:00.000Z"
}
```

This example illustrates the response schema; values are not a live scrape result.

## Discovery

- OpenAPI: https://scrapeagent.xyz/openapi.json
- x402 discovery: https://scrapeagent.xyz/.well-known/x402

## Current limitations

- Text extraction only; no structured field extraction, link list, metadata, or whole-site crawling yet.
- Redirects are deliberately rejected in the current safety preview.
- The safety preview is not production-approved until DNS rebinding is addressed with transport-level IP pinning or controlled egress, and payment settlement is tested end-to-end.
